title: Capacity Tuner Prescriptor and Fleet Utilization Synopsis
creator: Priya Patel
description: Goal: build a prescriptive ‘Capacity Tuner’ that synthesizes utilization signals, SLOs, and throughput guarantees to produce actionable capacity and autoscaling policy changes for dedicated fleets. Scope includes: (1) an offline analysis pipeline that aggregates per-pool utilization histograms, tail latency vs throughput curves, and KV-cache hit/miss patterns; (2) a prescriptor engine that maps observed workload shapes to recommended committed capacity changes (increase/decrease), autoscale target and cooldown settings, and suggested burst headroom; (3) an in-console synopsis tile and exportable report showing expected cost delta, SLO risk delta, and recommended rollout steps; (4) a lightweight change execution flow (UI + API) that can create a proposal for SRE review and schedule a safe rollout (canary + monitor). Out of scope for this ticket: automatic commit purchases, tenant-level pricing adjustments, and instrumentation changes requiring infra-wide schema updates.

acceptance_criteria: Prescriptor produces a ranked list of up to 10 actionable changes per pool (commit delta, autoscale min/max, cooldown) with an estimated cost delta and SLO risk score.
Offline pipeline can process 90 days of per-pool telemetry in under 2 hours for a 200-pool org using current k8s batch workers.
Simulation harness validates recommendation impact against a replay of 7 consecutive days with pass/fail thresholds for 99.9p latency and error rate.
Console shows a synopsis tile with trendline, recommended change, estimated monthly cost delta, and a one-click 'Create proposal' action that opens review workflow.
